source_registry.publisher: Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd.
claims_supported: The legal name is Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd.; the site identifies it as SBIC East Japan.
It was established on 1963-11-15.
Its operating area is Shizuoka, Nagano, Niigata and 18 prefectures eastward.
Its listed shareholders include local governments, chambers of commerce, financial institutions and business companies.
The company page explicitly lists Nagoya and Osaka Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation companies as sister companies.

source_registry.publisher: SBI Holdings, Inc. and SBI Securities Co., Ltd.
claims_supported: SBI Holdings and SBI Securities announced ChatGPT Enterprise adoption.
SBI Securities had begun use in January 2025; SBI Holdings began limited employee use in March 2025.
The announcement names SBI Holdings and SBI Securities, not any of the three SBIC regional investment companies.
The current public site positions Permission as a family-friendly AI product.
The site describes ASK rewards for positive behavior and says rewards can be redeemed for gift cards through Tremendous, subject to minimum thresholds.
Permission describes ASK as its native ecosystem token, with rewards and agent-to-agent coordination utility.
The documentation states a fixed supply of 100,000,000,000 ASK.
The official documentation lists Base contract 0xBB146326778227A8498b105a18f84E0987A684b4 and Polygon contract 0xaA3717090CDDc9B227e49d0D84A28aC0a996e6Ff.
The token is described as a LayerZero OFT live on Stargate.
The reviewed official token page does not list XRP or XRPL.
Permission identifies the Base ASK contract as 0xBB146326778227A8498b105a18f84E0987A684b4.
The project describes ASK as a reward and consent-based marketing/data-ownership token.
Ripple and Coinbase announced RLUSD availability across Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and Coinbase Retail on XRP Ledger, Base and Ethereum.
The announcement says Coinbase Global Exchange collateral availability would follow; it does not establish that RLUSD was already accepted as Global Exchange collateral at announcement time.

sbi_holdings.relationship_to_sbic_east_central_west: No corporate identity or ownership link to the three SBIC regional companies is established by the reviewed official profiles. Keep SBI Holdings as a separate entity unless a primary corporate record proves otherwise.
sbi_holdings.chatgpt_enterprise_status: SBI Holdings and SBI Securities announced adoption in 2025; this is not an SBIC regional-company deployment.

identity_resolution.conclusion: SBIC East, SBIC Central and SBIC West are three distinct Japanese regional Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation companies that list one another as sister companies. They are not SBI Holdings. The SBIC East ChatGPT seminar and SBI Holdings' separate ChatGPT Enterprise adoption are different events.

exact_phrase_findings.current_project_positioning: Family-friendly AI product and rewards; official token docs also describe agent-to-agent coordination and future governance/staking.

contract_scope.XRPL: No deployment or direct integration found in reviewed official Permission sources.

disconfirming_evidence: The generic phrase ASK Coin does not uniquely identify Permission ASK.
No direct Ripple, XRP, XRPL, SBI, Coinbase or Circle relationship was found in reviewed official Permission sources.
The current public product positioning emphasizes family AI and reward redemption; older documentation and tokenomics emphasize broader agentic-web utility. Preserve this product-positioning change.

findings: Two July 2026 Hyperliquid XRP whale-position stories remain secondary-source leads, not verified account records.
For the reported $13.84M short at 20x, $692,000 is only notional divided by stated leverage.
For the reported $16.3M long at 20x, $815,000 is only notional divided by stated leverage; a separately reported BTC deposit is not proof of the amount allocated as margin.
Neither simplified calculation establishes account equity, isolated/cross margin, liquidation buffer, realized P&L, or actual capital at risk.
Ripple Prime/Hidden Road regulatory net capital, customer-segregated funds, repo balances, XRP position notional and trader margin remain separate quantities.

exact_phrase_findings.finding: The phrase likely combines an SBIC East ChatGPT seminar with a separate SBI Holdings/SBI Securities ChatGPT Enterprise adoption announcement. Neither source establishes an OpenAI partnership with SBIC East, Central or West.

creator_identity_audit.rule: Do not attribute or inventory videos until a first-party cross-link or equivalent authoritative channel-ownership evidence resolves the candidate.

source_independence: The three SBIC regional company profiles are primary for their own legal identities but are sister-company sources, not independent corroboration of one another's group-wide claims.
SBI Holdings' ChatGPT Enterprise announcement is a separate corporate source and names SBI Holdings and SBI Securities, not the SBIC regional entities.
Permission's homepage, token docs and blog are all same-issuer sources; they are not independent corroboration.
Ripple's Coinbase RLUSD announcement is primary for the announced partnership but does not prove collateral use after the launch.
No source in this artifact has a byte-complete raw capture or SHA-256 receipt.
next_actions: Keep the SBIC legal-entity crosswalk as the canonical identity mapping for future SBIC phrase searches.
Continue exact-phrase research for actual capital only with a first-party account, filing or on-chain record; do not infer actual capital from leverage arithmetic.
Do not inventory Kamilah/Camilla Stevenson videos until channel ownership is established by first-party cross-link evidence.
Keep Permission ASK separate from XRP/XRPL unless a verified bridge, issuer relationship or on-chain interaction is found.
